verdict.rationale: A government service could reasonably publish a public data API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only visa routes, fees, processing times, an ID Check app and email alerts. There is no evidence of published API endpoints, a key-issuance path or stated rate limits.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
